description: Wnode Node Operator telemetry payload schema

memory_used_mb.description: Resident memory consumed by the operator process

memory_total_mb.description: Total physical memory available on the host

thermal_celsius.description: CPU or SoC temperature (null when unavailable)

battery_level.description: Battery charge level (null on mains-powered devices)

battery_charging.description: Whether the device is currently charging

uptime_seconds.description: Seconds since the operator process started

version.description: Semantic version of the running operator binary

capabilities.description: Hardware capability summary reported to the mesh

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of this telemetry snapshot
